title: Gower Quest
start: Talk to Andrew Gower at the cabbage farm south of Varrock, south-east of the Varrock lodestone.

recommended.t: Food and combat gear for the final battle
Use the desktop version during The Black Hole Experience to find objects

kills.t: Black Knight Titan (scales to the player) six times

rewards.t: Brassica Prime Godsword two-handed melee weapon override
Ability to have the old and graphically updated Black Knight Titan swap places
Speak to the Black Knight Titan in Behind the Scenes to toggle between his original and updated appearance.
Tim and Crunchy follower pets, obtained by speaking to them in Behind the Scenes
250 Skill XP lamp for use in a free-to-play skill, after speaking to Ian with level 10 or higher in all free-to-play skills
1500 Skill XP lamp for use in a free-to-play skill, after speaking to Paul with level 30 or higher in all free-to-play skills
12000 Skill XP lamp for use in a free-to-play skill, after speaking to Andrew with level 50 or higher in all free-to-play skills
The ability to reset the quest by searching a crate at the Gower Farm
This reset removes all quest rewards, including 1 quest point, unlike most replayable quests

steps.t: Speak to the Gowers at their farm next to rats and a cabbage patch south-east of the Varrock lodestone. [Chat: 1 So about that quest, then? › Accept]
p: The cabbages are outfitted with pink partyhats

steps.t: Search the crate in the room to the west to obtain pure essence.
Search the largest water barrel to the west of the southern entrance to obtain a brussels sprout.
Search the scarecrow in the south-western part of the farm with the cabbages to obtain a cruciferous mounting.
Search the food trough on the east side of the farm in the area with the giant rats to obtain a broccoli root.
Spin the broccoli root into broccoli string on the spinning wheel in the main room.
Use the brussels sprout on the cruciferous mounting to make it into an unstrung brassican amulet.
Use the "Flip" option on the pure essence to turn it into a life rune.
Use the broccoli string on the unstrung brassican amulet to create a brassican amulet.
Use the life rune on the brassican amulet to enchant it into a cabbagespeak amulet.
Equip the amulet and talk to Crispy the Cabbage south-west on the cabbage field.
Talk to the Gower brothers inside of the house. [Chat: Any]
Speak to the Cabbages again.
Speak to Andrew to receive the disk of returning.
Go to Dwarven Mines (entrance north-east of Falador lodestone).
Go to the "room" just before the south-westernmost one (Boot will be in the area).
Scan with the disk of returning.
The room is intentionally black. Move your cursor around to find the hidden objects:

sub.t: Search the table for a rock.
Use the rock on the wall to the northwest.
Right click on the table to look under it for an orange.
Eat the orange for a key.
Use the small key on the bumpy wall on the right for a tinderbox.
Use the tinderbox on the scary wispy thing and take the skull.
Use the skull on the unusual shape to the west.

steps.t: Talk to Thordur. [Chat: Any › Any › 1 Off I go, then.]
Talk to Spiral Orb (the purple spider DJ in the middle). [Chat: 1 What's up with the cabbage patches? › 2 I'll take a look around myself.]
Look around in this area for 3 NPCs: Lucien, Steve the Chaos Elemental, and Thok.

sub.t: You can complete the following in any order.

steps.t: Talk to Lucien, north-west of spiral orb and next to central bank portal. [Chat: 2 Can you help me fix the life altar? › 3 Not much, man.]
Enter the Central Bank Portal.
Talk to Claire Hick.
Talk to Ernie.
Check out the Locked Vault Door.
Leave the area.
Talk to Sphenishchev, located south of the portal next to the bar, the penguin next to Beastmaster Durzag. [Chat: 2 Will you help me break into the bank?]
Talk to Tim or Crunchy, just south-west of Spiral Orb (the DJ). [Chat: 3 Will you help me break into the bank?]
Ask the bartender for 5 cups of tea and hand them out to all 5 Environment artists around the bar.
Return to Tim and Crunchy. [Chat: 1 Everyone's been watered!]
Talk to Romeo, southeast of Beastmaster Durzag. [Chat: 2 Will you help me break into the bank? › 2 I'll see who I can find.]
Talk to each God Wars Boss to the east.
Return to Romeo. [Chat: 1 Yes, some people had ideas.]
Talk to Guthix, south of the bar. [Chat: 2 Will you help me break into the bank?]
Talk to one of the cabbages on the north-side of the bar.
Return to Guthix. [Chat: 1 Yes, they're very interested in working with you!]
Enter the Central Bank Portal.
Talk to Claire Hick.
Talk to Ernie. [Chat: 1 I have someone who wants to speak to you.]
Check out the locked vault door, then enter it.
Open the Bank Safety box, then search it for a fragment.
Leave the bank area.
Talk to Chaos Elemental, north of the Grand Exchange Maintenance, southwest of the bar. [Chat: 2 Can you help me fix the life altar? › 2 NO! No, thank you. › 3 Goodbye Steve!]
p: Robbing the bank with Sphenishchev's help

steps.t: Enter the Grand Exchange Maintenance portal.
Repair the Grand Exchange pipes. There are 3 different thickness pipes, each size must fit each other from the beginning to the end, the interface will close when it's correct.

sub.t: You should get the life altar fragment 2 after repairing, otherwise you should attempt to repair the pipes again.

steps.t: Leave the Grand Exchange area.
Talk to Thok, just north-west of Clawdia. [Chat: 2 Can you help me fix the life altar?]
Enter Beta Room Portal and talk to Max. [Chat: Any › 2 I'll get right on with that then.]
Max all 3 skills.

sub.t: First room: You get options to rock, trot, gallop, turn. Just click on the action displayed on top of the screen.
Second room: Fire at other battleships (searching desert island and bubbles give more xp too).
Third room: Stay inside the bank on the white floor tiles.

steps.t: Talk to Max for the third fragment.
Leave the area.
Enter the Life Altar Portal south, opposite of the Beta Room Portal.
Investigate Life altar.
Speak with the Black Knight Titan. [Chat: 4 Can we just get on with the boss fight?]
Kill it 6 times. 3 Before cutscene, 3 after.
Talk to any of the brothers.
Quest complete!
